title: Operador de Extrusora Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha fazer parte do nosso time Ecoflex!

A Ecoflex Embalagens acredita que uma boa embalagem vai além de proteger um produto: ela também deve contribuir para processos mais eficientes e para um futuro mais responsável.

Somos uma empresa do setor de embalagens localizada em Caieiras/SP. Trabalhamos diariamente com o propósito de proteger produtos, atender nossos clientes com qualidade e preservar o planeta.

Valorizamos a colaboração, o respeito, a responsabilidade, a segurança e a busca constante pela excelência. Acreditamos no desenvolvimento das pessoas e reconhecemos aqueles que demonstram comprometimento, vontade de aprender e dedicação ao trabalho.

Fazer parte da Ecoflex é integrar uma equipe próxima, contribuir diretamente para os resultados da empresa e encontrar oportunidades para aprender, crescer e se desenvolver profissionalmente.

Estamos em busca de um profissional experiente e responsável para integrar nossa equipe de Extrusão.

SOBRE A VAGA

Se você possui sólida experiência em extrusão de filmes plásticos pelo processo balão e busca uma empresa do setor de embalagens flexíveis na qual possa aplicar seus conhecimentos e continuar se desenvolvendo, esta oportunidade é para você!

Descrição de Atividades

  • Operar extrusoras de filmes plásticos tipo balão, Mono e Coex;
  • Realizar setups, regulagens e partidas de máquina;
  • Ajustar os parâmetros do processo, incluindo temperatura, pressão, velocidade e espessura do filme;
  • Controlar a estabilidade do balão durante todo o processo produtivo;
  • Acompanhar e garantir a qualidade do material produzido conforme as especificações da ordem de produção;
  • Efetuar trocas de matéria-prima e monitorar o consumo dos materiais durante a produção;
  • Trabalhar com matérias-primas virgens e recicladas;
  • Identificar e corrigir desvios no processo de extrusão;
  • Atuar na redução de perdas, refugos e desperdícios de matéria-prima;
  • Realizar os apontamentos e registros relacionados à produção;
  • Zelar pela conservação das máquinas, pela manutenção preventiva dos equipamentos e pela organização do setor;
  • Cumprir os procedimentos internos e as normas de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência mínima comprovada de 6 anos como Operador de Extrusora;
  • Experiência em extrusoras tipo balão, preferencialmente em equipamentos Mono e Coex;
  • Domínio do processo de extrusão de filmes em PEBD, PEBDL e PEAD;
  • Experiência com matérias-primas virgens e recicladas;
  • Conhecimento em setup, regulagem e partida de máquinas;
  • Conhecimento em controle de espessura e estabilidade do balão;
  • Domínio dos parâmetros do processo de extrusão;
  • Capacidade para identificar e corrigir desvios durante a produção;
  • Perfil proativo, responsável e comprometido com qualidade, segurança, produtividade e redução de perdas;
  • Organização, atenção e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA NOSSA EQUIPE?

Na Ecoflex, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Oportunidade de aplicar e ampliar seus conhecimentos técnicos;
  • Ambiente de trabalho próximo e colaborativo;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento por desempenho, dedicação e excelência;
  • Participação direta na melhoria dos processos e nos resultados da empresa;
  • Empresa comprometida com qualidade, segurança e responsabilidade ambiental;
  • Valorização de profissionais experientes, responsáveis e comprometidos.

HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO

  • Escala 3x3
  • 18h as 06h

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte ou ajuda de custo para combustível;

description:
Position Summary

The Fiscal Tax Specialist serves as the primary technical expert for all tax-related matters, ensuring the company's full tax compliance while identifying opportunities for tax optimization, mitigating tax risks, and guaranteeing the accurate calculation, reporting, and payment of taxes. This position plays a strategic role in aligning tax practices with current legislation and the company's business objectives.

Tax Compliance & Governance

  • Ability to interpret and apply complex tax legislation.
  • Project management and process improvement capabilities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Operations teams.

Liderar, desenvolver e expandir o negócio da IOT Lenses no Brasil e Cone Sul, combinando crescimento orgânico (Farmer) com abertura de novas contas e mercados (Hunter), fortalecendo relacionamentos estratégicos de longo prazo com clientes-chave e garantindo o cumprimento dos objetivos comerciais, de rentabilidade e posicionamento da marca.

  • Cumprir e superar os objetivos de vendas, mix de produto e rentabilidade por país.
  • Desenvolver planos comerciais específicos por mercado, considerando maturidade, potencial e estrutura local.

B. Desenvolvimento de Clientes

  • Manter e aprofundar relacionamentos com clientes estratégicos e contas-chave (laboratórios, redes ópticas, distribuidores).
  • Atuar como referência técnico-comercial de alto nível perante clientes seniores.
  • Garantir altos níveis de satisfação, retenção e crescimento por conta.
  • Liderar negociações complexas (pricing, contratos, exclusividades, lançamentos).

C. Desenvolvimento de Novos Negócios

  • Identificar e fechar novos clientes estratégicos em mercados-chave, especialmente no Brasil e mercados com alto potencial.
  • Detectar oportunidades de expansão geográfica, novos canais e alianças.
  • Liderar processos de conversão de clientes.

D. Representação Regional

  • Representar a IOT em feiras, congressos e eventos da indústria óptica.

title: Production Technician Trainee
description:
Position: Production Technician Trainee

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute routine inspections and predictive/preventive maintenance activities on topside systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations in accordance with company procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and supervisor instructions.

Responsibilities

Perform routine rounds throughout the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance and report abnormal conditions.

Execute first-line maintenance on process systems and equipment in accordance with CMMS work orders, daily inspections, and supervisor instructions.

Conduct line walks to verify proper system isolations before Permit to Work (PTW) release.

Prepare systems and equipment for maintenance activities, including draining, cleaning, and purging prior to handover.

Perform preservation activities, visual inspections, vibration, temperature and noise checks, oil changes and top-ups, cleaning of filters, strainers, drains, and sight glasses, gasket replacement (when specific competency is not required), and paint touch-ups.

Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures, SOPs, and safety requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Chemical, or related Engineering fields, from a recognized educational institution.
  • Recent graduate with up to 2 years of graduation.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial operations, maintenance, process systems, or equipment inspection gained through academic studies, internships, or practical training.
  • Willingness to learn and develop technical skills in offshore operations, first-line maintenance, equipment inspections, and Permit to Work (PTW) procedures.
  • English: Intermediate (mandatory for Brazilian candidates).

Benefits

Meal and food allowances.

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay).

Life Insurance.

Annual Bonus.

Private Pension Plan.

Childcare Allowance.

Note: This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

title: Quality Auditor
description:
Founded in the early 90s, SgT is an international company owned by Worms Safety and headquartered in Hong Kong. SgT specialises in apparel, textile and footwear, providing quality management solutions to major fashion brands, retailers and distributors worldwide.

SgT operates across 20 textile-production countries and employs more than 500 garment experts, technicians, textile engineers, QA professionals and auditors. Our solutions help customers secure the safety, quality and conformity of their products.

To support our continuous growth in Latin America, we are looking for an experienced Freelance Technical Auditor.

This opportunity is suitable for an independent textile engineer, technical auditor, quality manager or manufacturing specialist with strong hands-on experience in textile mills and garment-manufacturing facilities.

  • Conduct technical audits in textile mills, garment-manufacturing facilities and other relevant manufacturing sites.

title: Director of Operations - Cross-Border Payments
description:
About Velaro

Velaro is building cross-border payment infrastructure for businesses operating between Latin America and Asia.

We combine local payment rails, global financial infrastructure, FX and stablecoin settlement to help businesses move money across borders faster, more efficiently, and with greater transparency.

As we expand our payment corridors and operations across Brazil, Latin America and Asia, we are looking for a Director of Operations to build and lead the operational engine behind how money moves through Velaro.

About the Role

This is not a process-coordination role.

You will own the end-to-end operational infrastructure supporting Velaro's cross-border payment flows — from funding and liquidity to settlement, payout and reconciliation.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Commercial teams, as well as banks, payment providers, liquidity partners and other financial counterparties to ensure every transaction is executed reliably, efficiently and compliantly.

More importantly, you will help us turn operational complexity into scalable systems.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the operational execution of cross-border transactions across fiat and digital asset rails, including funding, FX conversion, stablecoin settlement, local payout and transaction completion.
  • Ensure transactions are settled accurately and on time. Build robust reconciliation, exception management and escalation processes across bank accounts, wallets, payment providers and counterparties.
  • Coordinate closely with Treasury, banking partners, payment providers, OTC and liquidity partners to ensure sufficient liquidity and reliable execution across payment corridors.
  • Design SOPs, controls, workflows and operational playbooks that allow Velaro to scale transaction volume and enter new markets without scaling manual work at the same rate.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn operational requirements into systems and tooling.
  • Own the operational response to failed, delayed or unusual transactions.
  • Establish escalation procedures, business continuity plans and incident-response frameworks to maintain reliable payment operations across markets and time zones.
  • Manage the operational relationship with banks, payment providers, exchanges, liquidity providers and other infrastructure partners.
  • Monitor partner performance, resolve operational issues and identify infrastructure gaps as Velaro expands into new corridors.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in payments, fintech, banking, treasury operations, FX or financial infrastructure
  • Experience leading payment or financial operations in a fast-growing environment
  • Strong understanding of cross-border payment flows, settlement and reconciliation
  • Hands-on experience working with banks, PSPs, payment networks, FX providers or liquidity partners
  • Familiarity with both traditional financial rails and digital asset / stablecoin settlement
  • Experience operating in regulated financial environments, with a practical understanding of KYC/KYB, AML and operational risk controls
  • Proven ability to design and scale operational processes, SOPs and controls
  • Strong analytical mindset and experience building operational KPIs and dashboards
  • Ability to manage incidents and make sound decisions under pressure
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across business, technical, compliance and external partner teams
  • Professional fluency in English and Portuguese

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B cross-border payments, trade payments or treasury infrastructure
  • Experience with Latin American payment markets, particularly Brazil and PIX
  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, on/off-ramp infrastructure or OTC settlement
  • Experience launching new payment corridors or markets
  • Familiarity with API-based payment infrastructure and operational automation
  • Mandarin proficiency

title: Performance Video Editor | DTC E-commerce
description:
Performance Video Editor | DTC E-commerce

Work Schedule: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

Location: Remote | LATAM & Philippines

Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Contract

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing DTC e-commerce company specializing in consumer products, with a strong presence across major retail channels.

They are looking for a Performance Video Editor to join their creative team and produce high-performing video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok. This is a great opportunity for an editor who understands that performance creative is about more than making a video look good—it's about creating content that captures attention, communicates value quickly, and drives conversions.

The team produces a high volume of advertising creatives, so we are looking for someone who is creative, efficient, proactive, and comfortable generating new ideas and testing different approaches.

What You'll Do

Video Editing & Performance Creative

  • Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.
  • Transform raw footage, creator content, scripts, and product footage into engaging advertising creatives.
  • Build strong hooks, pacing, re-hooks, visual storytelling, and CTAs designed to improve viewer retention and conversions.
  • Create multiple variations of creative concepts to support testing and optimization.
  • Source and incorporate relevant B-roll, stock footage, graphics, and other visual assets.
  • Adapt content for different platforms, placements, and formats.
  • Continuously improve creative based on feedback and performance insights.

Creative & Design

  • Create compelling visual assets that support video ads and marketing campaigns.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • Use Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar tools when needed.
  • Contribute new creative concepts and ideas for advertising campaigns.

Collaboration & Workflow

  • Organize and manage creative assets efficiently.
  • Follow established file naming and organization standards.
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions.
  • Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to execute a high volume of advertising content.
  • Be open to feedback and continuously look for ways to improve creative quality and workflow efficiency.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally focused on short-form content.
  • Strong experience creating direct-response / performance video ads.
  • Proven experience editing Facebook/Meta Ads.
  • At least 1 year of experience working with a DTC or e-commerce brand.
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Strong understanding of short-form advertising creative and what makes people stop scrolling.
  • Experience working with product-focused advertising.
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar design tools.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, typography, composition, and motion graphics.
  • Ability to take a script or creative concept and turn it into an engaging visual story.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality work consistently.
  • Fluent English, both written and verbal.
  • Strong time management and ability to meet daily and weekly deadlines.
  • Proactive, creative, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
  • Portfolio required, with relevant performance video examples.

Strongly Preferred Experience

  • We will prioritize candidates who have created advertising content for DTC/e-commerce brands, especially products such as:
  • Home and household products
  • Cleaning products
  • Pet-related products
  • Consumer electronics
  • Other physical consumer products
  • Experience creating Meta advertising creative is especially valuable.
  • Candidates whose experience is primarily in corporate video, traditional media, film, or organic social content without meaningful performance advertising experience are unlikely to be a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is not necessarily the most senior editor in the market. We are looking for someone with strong performance instincts, creativity, and good judgment who can understand a product, identify what will grab attention, and turn that insight into effective advertising creative.

You should be someone who:

  • Thinks beyond simply following a script.
  • Can come up with fresh creative ideas and angles.
  • Understands the difference between organic content and direct-response advertising.
  • Is comfortable testing hooks, formats, pacing, and creative concepts.
  • Learns quickly and applies feedback.
  • Can produce a high volume of quality creative without sacrificing attention to detail.

Tech Requirements

  • Computer: i7 processor or equivalent with at least 16GB RAM
  • Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum.

Schedule

  • Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)
  • Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST

Hiring Process

  • Candidates who move forward should be comfortable completing the following steps:
  • Skills Assessment
  • Trial Project
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Final Offer

The trial project will be used to evaluate editing quality, performance instincts, creativity, and technical execution.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully Remote
  • Full-Time, Long-Term Opportunity
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flex Days
  • Professional Development – Opportunities to learn and grow with the business
  • Opportunity to work directly on high-volume DTC performance advertising

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  • Lead the execution of the regional transition program, focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  • Prepare and manage the facility budget, process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  • Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  • Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  • Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities, including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  • Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

title: Online Teacher - Whole Child Education | IWS Online School
description:
We are not looking for a teacher. At least, not in the traditional sense.

At IWS Online School, we are hiring teachers across all subjects, and we are looking for people who genuinely care about children and believe education is about much more than delivering a curriculum.

We are looking for someone who notices when a child is quieter than usual. Someone who celebrates the small victories. Someone who understands that confidence, curiosity, character and belonging matter just as much as academic progress.

You may have many years of teaching experience.

You may have relatively little.

That is not the first thing we look at.

We can provide training in curriculum delivery, assessment, pedagogy, online teaching practice, technology and classroom management.

What is much harder to train is:

  • Genuine care for children
  • Empathy and emotional awareness
  • Positive energy and warmth
  • Strong character and responsibility
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • A real desire to make a difference in a child's life

The role

You will teach small groups of students online in your subject area and take responsibility for both their academic progress and their wider development.

This includes:

  • Delivering engaging, high-quality online lessons
  • Teaching your specialist subject effectively
  • Building strong relationships with students
  • Understanding each child as an individual
  • Monitoring progress and providing meaningful feedback
  • Supporting confidence, independence and curiosity
  • Working collaboratively with the wider IWS team
  • Communicating effectively with students, colleagues and families
  • Participating in training and continuous professional development

Who we are looking for

We are recruiting across a wide range of subjects, including core academic subjects, languages, humanities, sciences, technology, creative subjects and other specialist areas.

What matters most is not simply what you teach.

It is how you make children feel while they are learning.

We want teachers who see the child before the lesson.

There is a real young person on the other side of the screen, living one year of their childhood that will never come back.

We take that responsibility seriously.

Our aim is not simply to cover content. We want children to leave IWS stronger, more confident, more curious and better prepared for the world ahead of them.

If that is the kind of education you believe in, we would like to hear from you.

When applying, alongside your CV, tell us about one thing you have done for a child that you are still proud of.

Not your best lesson.

The child.

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Ponta Grossa/PR

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) e contempla posições em diversas áreas da unidade de PONTA GROSSA/PR.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Fundada em 1999, a WIN SOURCE ajuda fabricantes a garantir componentes eletrônicos críticos e a construir cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes em um mercado global cada vez mais complexo, com o apoio de uma equipe global de mais de 450 colaboradores.

Sobre a função

A função de Gerente de Vendas Internacionais na WIN SOURCE concentra-se na construção de parcerias estratégicas com OEMs globais, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e empresas de tecnologia, ajudando os clientes a solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos. Ao atuar com clientes dos setores de infraestrutura de IA, automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados, o profissional contribui para a continuidade da produção e para programas críticos nos quais o fornecimento confiável de componentes é essencial.

Esta posição desempenha um papel importante no apoio aos clientes na aquisição de componentes, gestão de escassez, mitigação de riscos de fim de vida (EOL), otimização de listas de materiais (BOM) e soluções de continuidade do fornecimento. Isso é feito em colaboração com as equipes globais de sourcing, compras e qualidade da WIN SOURCE, contribuindo para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes que impulsionam a inovação em diversos setores.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes globais e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável dos negócios nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Gerenciar toda a jornada de vendas, desde o desenvolvimento de mercado e o relacionamento com clientes até a gestão de solicitações de cotação (RFQs), negociação e fechamento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com OEMs, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e equipes de engenharia e compras para oferecer soluções confiáveis para o fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos.
  • Ajudar os clientes a enfrentar desafios na cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo escassez, riscos de fim de vida (EOL), transições de ciclo de vida e otimização de custos.
  • Colaborar com equipes globais e representar a WIN SOURCE em reuniões com clientes e eventos do setor.

Por que fazer parte da WIN SOURCE

Na WIN SOURCE, seu trabalho gera valor que vai além das vendas. Você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Conectar-se com empresas globais de tecnologia e ajudar a garantir os componentes críticos que mantêm as indústrias em operação.
  • Atuar em desafios reais da cadeia de suprimentos nos mercados automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados.
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com profissionais de engenharia, compras e cadeia de suprimentos em todo o mundo.
  • Utilizar a rede global de sourcing e o conhecimento de mercado da WIN SOURCE para oferecer soluções que vão além da distribuição tradicional.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira em uma organização global, na qual seu trabalho contribui para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes e para as tecnologias do futuro.

O que buscamos

  • Ter 3 anos ou mais de experiência em vendas B2B, gestão de contas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou outras funções comerciais relacionadas, com capacidade comprovada de desenvolver clientes e impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios.
  • Experiência em componentes eletrônicos, semicondutores, distribuição de componentes eletrônicos, EMS ou cadeias de suprimentos da indústria de manufatura é altamente desejável.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções orientadas à geração de valor.
  • Mentalidade focada no cliente, forte visão comercial e capacidade de gerenciar oportunidades ao longo de todo o ciclo de vendas.
  • Paixão por vendas internacionais e desenvolvimento de negócios, com atitude proativa, forte senso de responsabilidade e motivação para criar valor de longo prazo em um ambiente global.

Benefícios e crescimento profissional

Na WIN SOURCE, reconhecemos e recompensamos as pessoas que geram impacto.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário-base competitivo e estrutura de comissões sem limite, permitindo que profissionais de alto desempenho maximizem seu potencial de ganhos.
  • Oportunidades de vendas globais com clientes internacionais, contas estratégicas e exposição aos mercados mundiais de eletrônicos.
  • A oportunidade de atuar no centro da cadeia global de suprimentos de eletrônicos, ajudando fabricantes a garantir componentes críticos e solucionar desafios reais de negócios.
  • Treinamento profissional, desenvolvimento de conhecimento do setor e um plano de carreira claro rumo à liderança comercial.
  • Oportunidades de participar de mais de 50 feiras internacionais, reuniões com clientes e atividades comerciais globais.
  • Um ambiente multicultural e colaborativo, com equipes na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte.
  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira: Gerente de Vendas → Gerente Regional de Vendas → Gerente Regional Sênior de Vendas → Liderança Global de Vendas

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre nós:

A Penso Tecnologia é uma empresa de serviços de TI criada para possibilitar que os clientes utilizem a tecnologia a favor de seus negócios. Estamos alinhados a tecnologias globais para expandir o negócio de nossos clientes. Em nosso portifólio contamos com soluções de atuação on-premises e soluções de cloud computing.

A Penso está em franco crescimento e estamos à procura de talentos que estejam dispostos a novos desafios e crescimento.

Sonhamos Grande

Nos próximos anos esperamos crescer consideravelmente e nos tornarmos uma das maiores suítes corporativas do Brasil.

Qual será a sua missão na Penso?

Atuar na prospecção, desenvolvimento e fechamento de oportunidades comerciais no mercado governamental, junto a órgãos públicos, empresas estatais e demais organizações da Administração Pública.

É importante ter experiência em vendas para Governo, conhecimento em licitações e pregões eletrônicos e capacidade para identificar oportunidades, construir relacionamentos, conduzir processos de contratação pública e transformar oportunidades em novos negócios.

  • Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades no mercado público;
  • Identificar oportunidades em editais e portais de compras públicas;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas, da prospecção ao fechamento;
  • Realizar reuniões, apresentações e negociações comerciais;
  • Analisar editais, Termos de Referência e demais documentos do processo;
  • Participar e operar pregões eletrônicos e outras modalidades de contratação;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar propostas comerciais;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas técnica, jurídica, financeira e pré-vendas;
  • Manter pipeline, forecast e CRM atualizados;
  • Atuar na renovação, expansão e desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes;
  • Garantir o atingimento das metas comerciais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com vendas B2B e mercado governamental;
  • Vivência com licitações e pregões eletrônicos;
  • Conhecimento da Lei no 14.133/2021;
  • Experiência com plataformas de compras públicas, como Compras.gov.br;
  • Capacidade de interpretar editais e requisitos de contratação;
  • Experiência com prospecção, negociação e fechamento de negócios;
  • Conhecimento de soluções de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Boa comunicação, organização, negociação e foco em resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Carteira de relacionamento com órgãos públicos;
  • Vivência com soluções de Cloud, infraestrutura, segurança, backup, SaaS ou serviços gerenciados;
  • Cursos ou certificações relacionados a licitações ou vendas consultivas

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE's global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.

title: Project Manager
description:
The project is part of a next-generation SaaS technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry, processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale, high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project.
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Senior HR Analyst - Systems
description:
About Us

At Lightera, we empower our employees to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact on the world. We foster a supportive, dynamic, and inclusive workplace where people can thrive, collaborate, and drive positive change.

If you are looking for a rewarding career with opportunities to learn, lead, and contribute to cutting-edge innovation, this opportunity could be for you!

We are looking for a Senior HR Analyst, with a strong focus on HR Systems and Processes. This role will be responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance, optimization, integration, and transformation of HR systems, representing the needs and requirements of the LATAM region in global initiatives and ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines and solutions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Knowledge of systems integration, HR data management, reporting, and People Analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll processes and systems, HR operations, HCM platforms, and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian labor legislation and regulatory requirements; knowledge of other LATAM countries is a plus.
  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading HR technology implementation and transformation projects.
  • Experience working in multinational organizations, across regions and with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of process mapping, continuous improvement, and project management.

Responsibilities:

HR Systems & Technology

  • Represent the LATAM region in global HR technology discussions, projects, and forums.
  • Act as the regional point of contact for HR systems and HR operational processes.
  • Support the evaluation, configuration, testing, implementation, and optimization of HR technology platforms.
  • Ensure that business requirements from the LATAM region are properly identified and incorporated into global solutions.
  • Coordinate, together with the IT team, system updates, integrations, enhancements, and regional implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve HR processes through technology.
  • Monitor trends in HR technology, including AI and automation, and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Legacy Systems Management

  • Support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of existing HR systems.
  • Coordinate issue resolution, process improvements, and user support activities.
  • Support data migration, testing, validation, and system transition activities.
  • Ensure business continuity throughout migrations and transformation initiatives.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of systems, processes, and configurations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and security requirements, including Brazil's LGPD.

Project & Transformation Management

  • Participate in and coordinate regional HR technology and process transformation projects.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, stakeholder communications, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate collaboration among HR, IT, Finance, payroll providers, external partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Support change management activities, including training, communication, and user adoption.
  • Track project progress and support successful implementation and adoption.

Payroll & HR Operations

  • Partner with Payroll and HR Operations teams to improve process effectiveness, controls, and compliance.
  • Support payroll-related systems, integrations, reporting, and controls.
  • Support the development and standardization of regional HR procedures and controls.
  • Monitor changes in labor legislation and regulatory requirements across LATAM countries.
  • Assess and support the implementation of required changes to HR systems, processes, and controls.

title: Data Annotator - Brazil
description:
Brazil (pt-BR)

Job Title: Data Annotator, Fluent Bilingual Portuguese & English (Brazil-Based)

Location: Remote (Brazil residents only, not open internationally)

Pay: $4.00 per hour (approx. 10 to 15 hrs/week, up to a maximum of 30 hrs/week depending on availability)

Essential requirements (please only apply if you meet all of these):

  • You must be currently physically located in Brazil. This will be verified, and applications from candidates located elsewhere cannot be progressed.
  • You must be fluent in both English and Portuguese. This role requires strong command of both languages, not just one.
  • You must be eligible to work as a self-employed/freelance contractor (sole trader or via your own Personal Service Company). This will be verified.

Morpheus are partnered with a global data solutions provider working on a project for one of the world's largest social media platforms. They're looking for detail-oriented, freelance annotators based in Brazil to build a global network of independent contractors supporting this project on a flexible, work-from-home basis.

About the role: You'll analyse user search queries, label data, review social media posts and content, and answer questions based on your reasoning and the project guidelines provided. Because the content is specific to Brazil's local geography and culture, being based in Brazil and having strong dual fluency in Portuguese and English are both essential to the work itself, not just a nice-to-have.

Project details:

  • Duration: approximately 1 to 2 months depending on project status, with potential for ongoing work or transition to other projects based on performance.
  • Expected start date: ASAP. We're onboarding quickly for this project, so please only apply if you can start within the next few days and are able to respond promptly throughout the process.
  • Most contributors find that meeting project output needs takes around 10 to 15 hours per week, with flexibility to take on up to a maximum of 30 hours per week depending on project need and your availability.
  • Complete freedom to complete those hours at any time of day or night.

What you'll need:

  • Your own laptop or desktop computer (preferred over other devices)
  • Consistent, reliable internet access
  • Strong attention to detail and reasoning skills
  • Comfort working independently in a remote setting

Please note: while not expected, you may occasionally be exposed to sensitive content as part of this role.

As part of the application process, you'll complete a short assessment. This must be completed independently and without AI assistance; submissions are checked for this.

If you're based in Brazil, fluent in both English and Portuguese, and this sounds like the flexible, remote opportunity you've been looking for, apply now to find out more.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins

Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees.

Through NEXUSTM, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges.

Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence.

About the Role

The International Sales Manager role at WIN SOURCE focuses on building strategic partnerships with global OEMs, EMS providers and technology companies while helping customers solve complex electronic component supply challenges. Working with customers across AI infrastructure, automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics sectors, this role helps customers maintain production continuity and support critical programs where reliable component supply is essential.

This position plays an important role in supporting customers with component sourcing, shortage management, EOL risk mitigation, BOM optimization and supply continuity solutions through collaboration with WIN SOURCE's global sourcing, procurement and quality teams, and build more resilient supply chains that support innovation across industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic relationships with global customers and drive sustainable business growth across assigned markets.
  • Manage the complete sales journey, from market development and customer engagement to RFQ management, negotiation and closing.
  • Partner with OEMs, EMS providers, engineering and procurement teams to deliver reliable electronic component sourcing solutions.
  • Help customers navigate supply chain challenges, including shortages, EOL risks, lifecycle transitions and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with global teams and represent WIN SOURCE at customer meetings and industry events.

Why Join WIN SOURCE

At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond sales. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Connect with global technology companies and help secure the critical components that keep industries moving.
  • Work on real supply chain challenges across automotive, industrial, medical and advanced electronics markets.
  • Build strategic relationships with global engineering, procurement and supply chain professionals.
  • Leverage WIN SOURCE's global sourcing network and market expertise to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution.
  • Grow your career in a global organization where your work contributes to more resilient supply chains and future technologies.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth.
  • Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment.

Benefits & Career Growth

At WIN SOURCE, we recognize and reward people who create impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure, giving high performers the opportunity to maximize their earning potential.
  • Global sales opportunities with international customers, strategic accounts and exposure to worldwide electronics markets.
  • The opportunity to work at the center of the global electronics supply chain, helping manufacturers secure critical components and solve real business challenges.
  • Professional training, industry knowledge development and a clear career path toward commercial leadership.
  • Opportunities to participate in 50+ international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities.
  • A multicultural and collaborative environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America.
  • Career development path: Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Senior Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Leadership

Join WIN SOURCE

Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain?

Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins.

Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to:

Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.

title: Systems Engineer - Thermal Systems & Processes (Junior)
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Systems Engineer I – Thermal Systems & Processes to work on the development, modeling, and analysis of thermal systems and process plants within highly complex technology programs.

The professional will be responsible for developing mathematical models, performing performance simulations, sizing equipment, and preparing technical engineering documentation, contributing to all stages of product development, from concept definition through validation of engineering solutions.

The position involves working within a multidisciplinary team, collaborating with specialists in Systems Engineering, Design, Integration, Testing, and Product Development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop theoretical models for the simulation of systems and process plants;
  • Develop mathematical models for thermal and hydraulic system analysis;
  • Perform pressure drop calculations in fluid flow systems;
  • Develop heat transfer models using thermal resistance methodologies;
  • Select and size thermal machinery, such as pumps, compressors, and auxiliary equipment;
  • Select and size heat exchangers and other process equipment;
  • Develop Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs);
  • Develop, interpret, and review Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs);
  • Develop and review Line Lists;
  • Specify instruments and components for industrial systems;
  • Prepare engineering technical reports and project documentation;
  • Participate in technical reviews and support the definition of engineering solutions;
  • Interact with multidisciplinary teams to support the development and integration of technical solutions.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Thermal Sciences Engineering, or related fields.

Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in the development, analysis, or simulation of thermal systems and process plants.

Experience may have been acquired in industrial environments, research, development, or engineering projects.

Technical Knowledge

Thermal Systems & Process Engineering

  • Mathematical modeling of thermal systems;
  • Process plant simulation;
  • Fluid Mechanics;
  • Heat Transfer;
  • Applied Thermodynamics;
  • Pressure drop calculations;
  • Piping sizing;
  • Selection of pumps, compressors, and thermal machinery;
  • Heat exchanger sizing;
  • Development and interpretation of Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs);
  • Development and interpretation of Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs);
  • Development of Line Lists;
  • Industrial Instrumentation;
  • Preparation of technical engineering documentation.

Engineering Knowledge

  • Product Development Process;
  • Systems Engineering applied to product development;
  • Multidisciplinary systems integration;
  • Interpretation of technical standards;
  • Preparation of technical specifications;
  • Engineering problem analysis and resolution.

Tools

Experience with the following tools is desirable:

  • Engineering Equation Solver (EES);
  • Microsoft Office.

Desired Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;
  • Organization and planning;
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills;
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams;
  • Collaborative and results-oriented mindset;
  • Proactivity and sense of responsibility;
  • Critical thinking and technical decision-making skills;
  • Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment;
  • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience in the following areas will be considered a strong advantage:

  • Cryogenic systems and equipment;
  • Industrial plant development;
  • Refrigeration systems and thermal cycles;
  • Computational simulation of thermal systems;
  • Industrial processes involving gases and fluids;
  • Process equipment specification;
  • Development of complex PFDs and P&IDs;
  • Applied thermodynamic modeling;
  • Research & Development (R&D) environments;
  • High-complexity technology projects.

Languages

  • Advanced English, with emphasis on meetings with international clients, technical reading and interpretation, and preparation of technical documentation.

Availability

  • Availability for national and international travel, when required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for professionals with a strong foundation in thermal and process engineering, an analytical mindset, and an interest in developing innovative solutions for complex systems.

We expect professionals who are committed to technical excellence and capable of translating requirements into robust engineering models and solutions, working collaboratively and contributing to the success of our programs and the continuous development of the Systems Engineering team.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos buscando um Tech Lead para fazer parte do time!

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead / Arquiteto de Soluções AWS Sênior, com atuação hands-on, responsável por transformar necessidades de negócio e requisitos de clientes em soluções seguras, escaláveis, resilientes, observáveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.

Este profissional atuará desde a descoberta e pré-venda até o desenho, a implementação e a evolução das soluções, produzindo diagramas de arquitetura, decisões arquiteturais, estimativas técnicas, provas de conceito e direcionamentos para os times de desenvolvimento.

Também será responsável por exercer a liderança técnica da equipe, estabelecer padrões de engenharia, facilitar decisões, apoiar a resolução de problemas complexos e desenvolver tecnicamente profissionais de diferentes níveis de senioridade. A posição exige excelente comunicação com públicos técnicos, executivos, comerciais e clientes.

Arquitetura e decisões técnicas

  • Conduzir discovery técnico, identificando requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, restrições, riscos, integrações, requisitos regulatórios e critérios de sucesso.
  • Definir arquiteturas de alto e baixo nível, incluindo diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, rede, segurança, dados e implantação.
  • Documentar decisões por meio de Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), registrando contexto, alternativas, trade-offs, impactos e consequências.
  • Definir requisitos de disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, observabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup e recuperação de desastres.
  • Conduzir revisões com base nos seis pilares do AWS Well-Architected Framework: excelência operacional, segurança, confiabilidade, eficiência de performance, otimização de custos e sustentabilidade.
  • Avaliar alternativas técnicas e selecionar serviços AWS considerando adequação ao problema, segurança, custo total, esforço operacional e riscos de dependência.
  • Criar e manter padrões, arquiteturas de referência, guias e componentes reutilizáveis.

Pré-vendas e relacionamento com clientes

  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial durante discovery, qualificação e desenho de oportunidades.
  • Participar de reuniões, workshops e apresentações técnicas com clientes, adaptando a comunicação ao público técnico ou executivo.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em propostas técnicas, arquiteturas, escopo, premissas e planos de implementação.
  • Elaborar estimativas de esforço, capacidade, custos AWS e Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
  • Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs, questionários técnicos, requisitos de segurança e processos de due diligence.
  • Criar e apresentar demonstrações e provas de conceito, tratando objeções e explicando alternativas, riscos e trade-offs.
  • Realizar handoff estruturado entre vendas e delivery, assegurando alinhamento entre a solução proposta e a implementação.

Liderança técnica e desenvolvimento da equipe

  • Atuar como Tech Lead e principal referência técnica da equipe, sem necessariamente exercer gestão administrativa de pessoas.
  • Facilitar decisões e criar alinhamento entre engenharia, projetos, produto, segurança, operações e vendas.
  • Estabelecer padrões de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes, segurança, observabilidade, documentação e revisão de código.
  • Orientar o roadmap técnico, a evolução das plataformas e a priorização de débito técnico e riscos de engenharia.
  • Conduzir design reviews, code reviews e revisões de prontidão para produção com critérios objetivos de qualidade.
  • Realizar mentoria, pairing e feedback técnico, apoiando planos de desenvolvimento de profissionais júnior, pleno e sênior.
  • Promover treinamentos internos, comunidades de prática e compartilhamento de conhecimento, reduzindo dependências individuais.
  • Apoiar recrutamento, entrevistas e avaliação técnica de candidatos.
  • Influenciar decisões técnicas com clareza, respeito e dados, mesmo sem autoridade hierárquica direta.

Implementação, operação e melhoria contínua

  • Liderar o desenho e a implementação de soluções utilizando Terraform e práticas avançadas de Infrastructure as Code.
  • Desenvolver provas de conceito e componentes críticos utilizando Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Go ou outra linguagem adotada pela equipe.
  • Definir e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, controles DevSecOps, estratégias de deployment e automação de testes.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização, integração de sistemas legados e adoção responsável de serviços gerenciados.
  • Integrar soluções de GenAI, APIs de LLMs e automação inteligente com controles de segurança, privacidade, avaliação e observabilidade.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado e liderar tecnicamente incidentes críticos, análise de causa raiz e post-mortems sem culpabilização.
  • Conduzir ações de FinOps, capacity planning e otimização contínua de custos, performance e confiabilidade.

Serviços e conhecimentos relevantes /Domínio

Governança e identidade

AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, IAM Identity Center, SCPs, AWS Config, CloudTrail, landing zones e ambientes multi-account.

Redes e entrega

VPC, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Elastic Load Balancing, CloudFront, API Gateway, Direct Connect e VPN.

Segurança

KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, Macie, least privilege e threat modeling.

Computação

EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e arquiteturas serverless.

Dados e integração

S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, Kinesis, MSK, Glue, Athena e Redshift.

Observabilidade e resiliência

CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, AWS Backup, Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Service, Elastic Disaster Recovery, SLI/SLO e testes de recuperação.

Engenharia e automação

Terraform em ambientes complexos, módulos e pipelines IaC; conhecimento de CloudFormation ou CDK; CI/CD, Git, testes automatizados e Systems Manager.

FinOps

Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Cost and Usage Reports/Data Exports, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, tagging e alocação de custos.

IA generativa

Amazon Bedrock, Guardrails, Knowledge Bases, Agents, integração segura de modelos, avaliação, privacidade e observabilidade de aplicações de IA.

Profundidade esperada em AWS

Espera-se conhecimento aprofundado em pelo menos quatro dos domínios AWS listados acima e capacidade comprovada de avaliar, selecionar e integrar serviços adequados nos demais domínios. A posição não exige domínio prático de todos os serviços citados, mas requer visão sistêmica, entendimento de trade-offs e habilidade para aprender rapidamente novas capacidades da plataforma.

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação oral e escrita clara, adaptada a engenheiros, executivos, clientes e profissionais comerciais.
  • Capacidade de facilitar reuniões, workshops e decisões técnicas complexas.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo e habilidade de influenciar sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade e interesse genuíno em ensinar, mentorar e desenvolver outros profissionais..
  • Escuta ativa, abertura a feedback e maturidade para conduzir conversas técnicas difíceis.
  • Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar velocidade, qualidade, segurança, risco e custo.
  • Orientação ao cliente e compreensão do impacto das decisões técnicas no negócio.
  • Senso de ownership, pragmatismo, colaboração e responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Capacidade de negociar prioridades, lidar com ambiguidades e administrar conflitos técnicos.
  • Organização para atuar simultaneamente em oportunidades comerciais e projetos em execução.

Requisitos

  • Experiência relevante em engenharia de software, infraestrutura ou cloud, com atuação significativa em AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead, Arquiteto de Soluções ou principal referência técnica de uma equipe.
  • Histórico de desenho, implantação e sustentação de soluções AWS em produção.
  • Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com clientes ou apoiando atividades de pré-venda.
  • Capacidade de produzir e apresentar diagramas utilizando ícones oficiais AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software, APIs, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, integração orientada a eventos e serverless.
  • Experiência com Terraform, pipelines CI/CD, containers, observabilidade e práticas de DevSecOps.
  • Capacidade de estimar esforço, capacidade, custo e riscos técnicos de soluções.
  • Conhecimento de segurança por design, governança, alta disponibilidade, disaster recovery e FinOps.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional.
  • Certificação AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.
  • Certificações AWS Certified Security - Specialty ou AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional.
  • Experiência com Azure, GCP, ambientes híbridos ou estratégias multi-cloud.
  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock, agentes, RAG, avaliação de modelos e soluções corporativas de IA generativa.
  • Experiência em consultoria, serviços profissionais, ambientes regulados ou atendimento a clientes enterprise.
  • Inglês técnico ou avançado para documentação, apresentações e interação com clientes ou parceiros internacionais.
